# Adding update notifications to Hodoku software (2026-01-26 18:42Z)

_**User (2026-01-26 18:43Z)**_

I would like to add a notification to the program.
When either the automatic update checker runs or the manual update checker is run, after the check is finished if there is no update available have a popup appear in the center of the screen that says “You are using the latest version of Hodoku software.”. After 5.0 seconds have the popup disappear.
Also please verify that if a new version id found that there is notification stating that fact. If there is no notification process then let me know about it.
